title: Charnel Ground Dwellers
html:
• Aṅguttara Nikāya 5.184 Numbered Discourses 5.184
  • 19. Araññavagga 19. Wilderness Dwellers

Sosānikasutta Charnel Ground Dwellers

“Pañcime, bhikkhave, sosānikā. “Mendicants, these five dwell in a charnel ground. Katame pañca? What five? Mandattā momūhattā sosāniko hoti …pe… idamatthitaṁyeva nissāya sosāniko hoti. One may dwell in a charnel ground because of stupidity … corrupt wishes … madness … because it is praised by the Buddhas … or for the sake of having few wishes … Ime kho, bhikkhave, pañca sosānikā”ti. These are the five who dwell in a charnel ground.”

Catutthaṁ.
